spatial_aggregation: MERRA-2 native grid; unweighted mean of available SMAP and IMERG pixel centers inside each 0.5 x 0.625 degree cell. No upsampling. Whole source-cell extents fit inside the downloaded bounding box.
time_alignment: MERRA-2 and IMERG use UTC calendar days; SMAP is one 13:30 UTC snapshot, not a daily average.
duplicate_resolution: Highest SMAP processing-version filename per date; IMERG Final takes precedence over Late.
temperature_extremes: Extremes over 24 hourly means at regional 2 m air temperature; not instantaneous or ground frost measurements.

reference_boundary.purpose: spatial domain mask only; not a time-varying predictive feature
